entry.tooltip.en: Skill center: browse and manage loaded skills
entry.tooltip.zh: 技能中心：浏览与管理已加载的 skill

groupHint.bundled.en: Global skills shipped with DSH and its plugins
groupHint.bundled.zh: DSH 内置与插件随附的全局技能

groupHint.project-dsh.en: Located in the project directory, scoped to its workspace
groupHint.project-dsh.zh: 存放于项目目录，作用于所在项目

groupHint.project-agents.en: Located in the project directory, scoped to its workspace
groupHint.project-agents.zh: 存放于项目目录，作用于对应项目

groupHint.user-dsh.en: Global skills (~/.dsh/skills), shared across all projects
groupHint.user-dsh.zh: 全局技能（~/.dsh/skills），本机所有项目共享

groupHint.user-agents.en: Global skills (~/.agents/skills), shared across all projects
groupHint.user-agents.zh: 全局技能（~/.agents/skills），本机所有项目共享

groupHint.runtime.en: Skills registered at runtime by plugins
groupHint.runtime.zh: 插件运行时代码内嵌注册

list.empty.zh: 当前没有已加载的 skill。

list.invokableTooltip.en: The model can invoke this skill automatically; manual /skill commands remain available
list.invokableTooltip.zh: 模型可自动调用该技能；手动 /skill 指令不受影响

list.noFileTooltip.en: This skill is registered at runtime or shipped by a plugin, so it has no SKILL.md file
list.noFileTooltip.zh: 该技能由插件在运行时注册或随包提供，没有 SKILL.md 文件

list.noFileHint.en: This skill has no local SKILL.md file, so it cannot be enabled/disabled, edited, or deleted here.
list.noFileHint.zh: 该技能没有本地 SKILL.md 文件，无法在此启用/禁用、编辑或删除。

list.providerFileTooltip.en: This skill has a file supplied by its plugin provider, outside the skill roots this panel scans
list.providerFileTooltip.zh: 该技能的文件由插件 provider 提供，未落在本面板扫描的技能根目录下

list.providerFileHint.en: This skill is supplied by a plugin and does have a SKILL.md file, but it sits outside the skill roots this panel scans, so it cannot be enabled/disabled, edited, or deleted here.
list.providerFileHint.zh: 该技能由插件提供、确有 SKILL.md 文件，但不在本面板扫描的技能根目录下，因此无法在此启用/禁用、编辑或删除。

list.enabled.en: Enabled: invokable by the model (click to disable)
list.enabled.zh: 已启用：模型可调用（点击禁用）

list.disabled.en: Disabled: not invokable by the model (click to enable)
list.disabled.zh: 已禁用：模型不可调用（点击启用）

create.root.user.en: User skills (~/.dsh/skills, available to all projects)
create.root.user.zh: 用户技能（~/.dsh/skills，所有项目可用）

create.name.en: Skill name (kebab-case, same as the directory name)
create.name.zh: 技能名（kebab-case，与文件目录同名）

create.description.en: Description (how the model decides when to trigger)
create.description.zh: 描述（模型判断触发条件的依据）

create.empty.en: Skill name/description/content must not be empty
create.empty.zh: 技能名/描述/内容不能为空

create.note.en: The skill takes effect immediately (skill-filesystem hot-scans). Its content is injected into the model context as instructions — do not put sensitive information in it.
create.note.zh: 创建后立即生效（skill-filesystem 会热扫描）。内容会作为指令注入模型上下文——不要写入敏感信息。

edit.note.en: Only the description, when-to-use, and body change: the name, location, and enabled state stay as they are. The edit takes effect immediately (skill-filesystem hot-scans).
edit.note.zh: 只改描述、适用场景与正文：技能名、位置和启用状态保持不变。保存后立即生效（skill-filesystem 会热扫描）。

filter.emptyWorkspace.en: No skills under the current filter.

workspace.isolatedHint.en: This skill belongs to workspace "{workspace}" and is isolated from the current session context
workspace.isolatedHint.zh: 该技能属于工作区「{workspace}」，在当前会话上下文隔离不生效
